metadata.scenario: A customer calls to gather information about the company’s shipping options and timeframes. Category: General Information.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, my name is Patricia Wilson. I was referred by Dr. Anderson regarding my mother’s upcoming hip replacement. Nice to meet you, Patricia! How can I assist you with your mother’s care? I’m looking for information about post-surgery care options after her operation. Absolutely, we offer specialized post-surgery recovery care. That sounds good. What does that include? Our post-surgery recovery care includes assistance with daily activities, medication management, and wound care. How long do the sessions usually last? Sessions typically last between 1 to 3 hours, depending on your mother's needs. And what are the costs associated with that service? The pricing for post-surgery recovery care ranges from $85 to $110 per session. Okay, that sounds reasonable. Do you schedule these sessions in advance? Yes, we recommend scheduling them in advance to ensure availability. Great! How soon can the care start after her surgery? We can typically begin care within 24 hours of discharge from the hospital. That's perfect. What do I need to do to set this up? I can help you with that. First, let’s discuss your mother's specific needs. Yes, she will need help with her mobility and medication management. Understood. I can also arrange a Registered Nurse to assist her with those needs. That sounds good. Can you provide me with the nurse’s information? Sure! Robert Davis is our Registered Nurse for that. His extension is 210. Thank you. Is there anything else I should know before booking? It would be helpful to have your insurance information ready for authorization. I’ll gather that. Can I call back to finalize everything? Of course, you can reach us at this number or my direct line at +13165559201. Thank you so much for your help, Margaret! You’re welcome, Patricia! Looking forward to assisting your mother. I appreciate it. Have a great day! You too! Bye now.
